CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets Have Cross-Region Replication Enabled
Description: S3 buckets have been observed without having Cross-Region Replication configured to automatically replicate objects to a destination bucket in a separate AWS region.
Risk: Without Cross-Region Replication, data loss or extended downtime can occur if an entire AWS region experiences an outage, impacting data availability, business continuity, and disaster recovery.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Cross-Region Replication for business-critical S3 buckets to ensure geographic redundancy, business continuity, and compliance with data backup and disaster recovery policies.
